Keywords: kholm defense and limits of reconstruction
RagShortTexts: Kholm is an important center developed by Danylo.
Defence, residence and supplies jointly support the court.

Variants.Content: Kholm combines court, residence and defence as a center developed by Danylo. Position and works strengthen leverage, but food, repairs and cooperation remain necessary. Concentrated people and wealth create daily water, storage and carriage needs.
Kholm guards stores and approaches as well as elevated ground. Construction and watches need separate hands and actual relief before defenders leave their posts.
Investment at Kholm must match provision. Defensible works also need feeding; envoys, food reserves and local support preserve practical options under pressure.
A center attracts workers and sellers but demands building labor and lodging. Payment for materials and space for families influence continued residence.
